title: SDD lab role registry
description: Role vocabulary and port ranges for the block-of-10 port-allocation scheme (ADR-0004). Tools/sdd_cli/k8s_ports.py reads this instead of hardcoding roles — consumers add roles (worker, scheduler, ...) here without touching Python. The shipped file defines the built-in web/api/database defaults; tools/sdd_cli/k8s_ports.py falls back to those defaults when the file is absent (bare checkout).

hostPortBase.description: Host-port block 0 start for the role's range (blocks of 10: base..base+9, base+10..base+19, ...). Host ports are host-scoped — dev/qa/prod consume consecutive slots (base, base+1, base+2). Shipped: web 8081, api 5002.

nodePortOffset.description: NodePort offset added to env_code*1000 (dev 30, qa 31, prod 32) — blocks of 10 per env per role. Shipped: web 80 (dev 30080+), api 500 (dev 30500+). Must keep nodePorts under the K8s 32768 ceiling for every environment.

containerPort.description: Default container port for apps of this role when ports.json appPorts has no explicit entry (scaffold fallback). Shipped: web 80, api 5000, database 5432.

portEnv.description: When true, scaffold_k8s emits a stack-independent PORT env var in the app Deployment (the AI scaffold skill generates the Dockerfile that consumes it). Shipped: api only.

healthCheck.description: How the health probe checks services of this role: http (GET /health on the host port) or tcp (TCP connect to the host port — databases and other non-HTTP services). Shipped: web/api http, database tcp.
